subject.title: Control UI Dashboard v2 freezes on Chrome 146 (works fine in Firefox)

question: Should this issue be handled by first proving and removing a current Chromium render trigger, or by adding an explicit browser-safe fallback mode for affected Control UI users?
rationale: The report is credible, but current main changed one suspected trigger and no live proof identifies the remaining current-main cause; a fallback would add user-visible Control UI behavior.

options.title: Reproduce then fix trigger
options.body: Use live Chromium diagnostics on current main to identify the shell/layout trigger and land the narrowest code fix.

options.title: Add safe UI fallback
options.body: Design an explicit simple-shell or safe-mode fallback for affected Chromium builds, accepting a broader product surface.

options.title: Close after no repro
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the missing current-main Chromium reproduction makes the report no longer actionable.

recommendation.title: Reproduce then fix trigger
recommendation.body: Use live Chromium diagnostics on current main to identify the shell/layout trigger and land the narrowest code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns the strongest feature-history trail across Dashboard v2 and the responsive-refresh mitigation that references this issue.
